---
title: "Analyzing School District Reading Scores"
author: "Isabella Thaxton"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---


```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/seda_2025.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)
dbplyr_dist <- tbl(con, "district_scores")
```

```{r}
#| include: false
#| cache: true
#| cache.extra: !expr file.mtime("data/seda_2025.duckdb")
districts_2015 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, district_name, state, rla_2015 = rla_score)
districts_2023 <- dbplyr_dist |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(district_id, rla_2023 = rla_score)
score_change <- inner_join(districts_2015, districts_2023, by = "district_id") |>
  transmute(district_id, district_name, state, rla_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015) |>
  collect()

state_scores <- tbl(con, "state_scores")
states_2015 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2015, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, state_name, rla_2015 = rla_score)
states_2023 <- state_scores |>
  filter(year == 2023, !is.na(rla_score)) |>
  select(stateabb, rla_2023 = rla_score)
state_change <- inner_join(states_2015, states_2023, by = "stateabb") |>
  transmute(
    stateabb,
    state_name,
    rla_2015,
    rla_2023,
    score_change = rla_2023 - rla_2015
  ) |>
  arrange(stateabb) |>
  collect()
print(state_change)
```

```{r}
#| include: false
ggplot(score_change, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "darkorange"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Negative or no change", "TRUE" = "Positive"),
    name = "Reading score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of District Reading Score Changes",
    subtitle = paste("Districts with data in both years (n =", nrow(score_change), ")"),
    caption = "Change is the 2023 score minus the 2015 score; the dashed line marks no change.",
    x = "Change in reading score",
    y = "Number of districts"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  state_change,
  aes(
    y = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023),
    x = rla_2015,
    xend = rla_2023,
    yend = fct_reorder(state_name, rla_2023),
    color = score_change > 0
  )
) +
  geom_segment(
    arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(0.12, "inches"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rla_2015), color = "gray60", size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "steelblue", "TRUE" = "darkorange"),
    labels = c("FALSE" = "Decline or no change", "TRUE" = "Improvement"),
    name = "Score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "State Reading Score Changes, 2015 to 2023",
    subtitle = "States are ordered by their 2023 reading score",
    caption = "Gray dots mark 2015 scores; arrows point to 2023 scores.",
    x = "Reading score",
    y = NULL
  )
```
